Per-organization
concurrency is capped (default **2** concurrent runs); exceeding it returns
`429` with `details.re

ason: "CONCURRENT_RUN_LIMIT"` — wait for an active run
to finish.

If a server answers `401 OAUTH_REQUIRED`, complete the OAu
th flow yourself\n(the SDK's `runOAuthLogin` handles interactive, headless, and\nclient-credentials flows) and upload the token to
one of the server's\n[accounts](#server-accounts). Subsequent runs inject the stored token, and\nrefresh it server-side when you

stored a refresh token.

## Reasoning effort

A reasoning effort is a **saved setting on a model selection**, not a free-stand
ing\nfield. A `ModelSelection` (`modelId`, `source`, an optional `connectionRef`, and a\n`fallback`) carries it as `settings.reaso

ningEffort`, and the same shape is
accepted everywhere a model choice is saved:

| Where | Field |
| - | - |
| Client (`PATCH
/projects/{projectId}/clients/{client}`) | `set.modelSelection` (or `config.modelSelection` on a whole-config replacement) |\n| P
roject environment (`POST`, `PATCH`, `POST .../ensure-adhoc`) | `modelSelection`, read back on the environment |\n| Eval case (`PO
ST`, `PATCH .../cases`) | `models[].selection`, read back on the case |\n| Eval suite (`PATCH /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{s

lId": "openai/gpt-5",
 "source": "hosted",
 "settings": { "reasoningEffort": "high" },
 "fallback": { "provi
of\n them a model accepts is `supportedReasoningEfforts` on each row of the public\n `GET /v1/models` catalog. An empty or absen
t list means no effort is offered for\n that model — do not guess one.\n* **Applied or refused, never dropped.** A saved effort i
s applied by the route\n the run takes and recorded on the execution record, or refused with\n `capability_missing` before any s
pend. An effort replaces the sampling\n temperature.\n* **A selection belongs to one model.** It must be for the `model` / `model
Id` it\n sits beside (`400` otherwise); sent alone it pins its own model. A bare model\n change on a suite or environment drops
a selection saved for the old model\n instead of failing.\n* **Cases keep their selections.** A `models` PATCH replaces the array
, but an\n entry that omits `selection` keeps the case's existing selection for that\n model. Send `selection: null` to drop it.

* **Clearing.** `null` clears a saved selection on a client `set`, an environment
 or a suite, keeping the bare model id.
* *
*Never a secret.** A selection has no credential field; an unknown key\n (`apiKey`, …) is a `400`.\n* **Environments need the cap
ability.** `GET .../environments/capabilities`\n reports `modelSelections`; an older deployment rejects the field.\n* **`advanced
Config.reasoningEffort` is retired.** It was never applied, so\n writing it is a `400` pointing at `models[].selection.settings`,

and a stored
 value is refused by the runner.

`POST /chat-sessions/messages` takes a top-level `reasoningEffort` for a
per-
request effort. Like `temperature`, it is pinned on the session's **first\nturn** (a continuation that restates it is refused), it

wins over the effort a
`hostId`'s saved selection carries, and it cannot be combined with `temperature`.

The SDK, CLI, MCP to
ols and in-app agent all go through the same operations:\n`--effort` / `reasoningEffort` is a shorthand that edits the selection t

he target
already has, and is refused (`send modelSelection`) when there is none.

## Not in the API yet

To set expectations

while in preview, these are **not** available over the API
today (most exist in the hosted inspector UI):

* Creating or revok
ing API keys (UI-only by design — see [Authentication](#authentication))\n* Chat and conformance suites\n* Browser-based OAuth flo
ws initiated by the API (complete OAuth yourself,\n then upload the token to one of the server's [accounts](#server-accounts))\n\

nIf one of these blocks you, tell us on
[Discord](https://discord.gg/JEnDtz8X6z) — it directly shapes what we
stabilize first.

## Versioning & stability

* The API is **path-versioned** (`/api/v1`). When it reaches general
 availability, breaking chan
ges will require a new version path.\n* **During the preview**, breaking changes to v1 may still happen; we'll note\n them in the
[changelog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/changelog/overview.md).\n* **Additive changes** — new endpoints, new optional request fields,
new\n response fields, new error codes — are considered non-breaking and can ship\n at any time. Write clients that ignore unkn

own fields.
* Error **codes** are stable identifiers; error **messages** are not.

### Renamed surfaces

Three nouns this API
used are now what the product calls them: `scenario` is\n**study**, `journey` is **goal**, and `wave` is **swarm run**. The paths

, the
operation names, the SDK types and the noun-bearing response fields all moved:

| Was | Is |
| - | - |
| `/projects/{pr
ojectId}/scenarios[/{scenarioId}]` | `/projects/{projectId}/studies[/{studyId}]` |\n| `/projects/{projectId}/user-testing/scenario
s/{scenarioId}/…` | `/projects/{projectId}/studies/{studyId}/…` |\n| `/projects/{projectId}/environments/{environmentId}/scenario`
| `.../environments/{environmentId}/study` |\n| `/projects/{projectId}/journeys[/{journeyId}]` | `/projects/{projectId}/goals[/{g
oalId}]` |\n| `/projects/{projectId}/journey-runs/{runId}` | `/projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` |\n| `/projects/{projectId}
/journeys-overview`, `.../journey-findings` | `.../goals-overview`, `.../goal-findings` |\n| `/projects/{projectId}/waves/{waveId}
/insights` | `/projects/{projectId}/swarm-runs/{swarmRunId}/insights` |\n\nResponse fields followed their nouns: `scenarioId` → `s

tudyId`, `journeyId` →
`goalId`, `waveId` → `swarmRunId`, and `sessionsPerTarget` → `iterations`.

Two reads became one: `get_s
cenario` served the execution settings and\n`get_user_testing_scenario` served the environment id and the insights\nenvelope. `get

_study` returns both, and the two caller-dependent fields are
absent rather than null when you may not have them.

**Every old
path still works** and is unchanged, including its old response\nspellings. Each one answers with `Deprecation: true` and a `Link`
header naming\nits successor. They are undocumented on purpose — the spec is what a new\nintegration reads — and they are removed

at general availability.

A handful of operations kept their names through the rename and so have no
deprecated twin to hold t
he old field spellings. `get_swarms_overview`,\n`create_swarm` and `update_swarm` emit both and accept either — never both in\none

request — until general availability.

### Vocabulary

A name can move behind an alias; a VALUE cannot. `sourceType` is one f
ield with\none string in it, and a client switching on `\"scenario\"` has no second name to\nfall back to. So the values negotiate

.

Send `x-mcpjam-api-vocabulary: 2` and the renamed values read canonically:

| Field | Vocabulary 1 | Vocabulary 2 |
| - |
- | - |\n| session `sourceType` | `scenario` | `study` |\n| session `parentRef.kind` | `scenario`, `journeyRun` | `study`, `goalRu
